verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped credentials is a fair axis for an email app that exposes an MCP surface to agents, so the story applies. The evidence shows the only way to authenticate is pasting a full Better Auth browser session cookie into the Authorization header, with OAuth marked 'coming soon'. Nothing documents scoped, least-privilege, or agent-specific credentials, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
